title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Singapore or Tokyo, Japan

About the Team

The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.

What You'll Do

Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer for Zero Trust to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence.

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, and Teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.
  • Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.
  • Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.
  • Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.
  • Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.
  • Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.

What We're Looking For

  • You have a minimum of 4 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.
  • Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.
  • Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IAM) systems, such as Okta, Ping Identity, or Azure Active Directory.
  • Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, LDAP) and secure web gateway technologies.
  • Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.
  • Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.
  • You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actualrace, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

title: Senior Account Executive, Enterprise (Private Accounts)
description:

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

The Senior Account Executive, Enterprise will be responsible for developing/closing business with a number of private accounts in their assigned account list through working with the partner sales community. The primary focus is aimed at closing sales opportunities and is achieved by collaborating with partners to identify, develop, accelerate, up-sell and close transactions.

What You'll Do

  • Leverage partners to close sales with their end customers

title: Customer Success & Onboarding (m/w/d) – Teilzeit, 20 Std./Woche
description:
Baue einen skalierbaren Customer-Success-Bereich auf

Novo AI ist ein Technologieunternehmen aus Hannover. Mit unserer WatchMen-Plattform und KI-Sensorik helfen wir produzierenden Unternehmen, Maschinenzustände, Stillstände und Produktionskennzahlen transparent zu machen und ihre Fertigung besser zu verstehen.

Damit unsere Kunden schnell starten und unsere Lösungen im Alltag sicher nutzen können, bauen wir unser Onboarding und Customer Success von Grund auf auf. Dafür suchen wir dich in Teilzeit mit zunächst 20 Stunden pro Woche. Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden persönlich und entwickelst zugleich wiederverwendbare Inhalte und intelligente Abläufe. Du kannst Verbesserungen selbst vorantreiben und arbeitest dabei mit Kollegen zusammen, die dich bei der Umsetzung unterstützen. Unser Ziel: mehr Kunden gut begleiten und den manuellen Aufwand pro Kunde reduzieren.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Customer Success aufbauen: Du lernst die zugeteilten Kunden, ihre Ansprechpartner, Ziele und offenen Anliegen kennen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Team entwickelst du einen klaren Weg vom ersten Einführungsgespräch bis zur regelmäßigen Nutzung von WatchMen.

  • Onboarding-Workflows gestalten: Du definierst nachvollziehbare Schritte, Zuständigkeiten und Meilensteine – etwa Begrüßung, Kick-off, Plattform-Einführung, erste Anwendung und Folgetermine. Auch Bestandskunden, die bisher wenig Begleitung hatten, holst du gezielt ab.

  • Onboarding-Videos und Hilfen entwickeln: Du planst und erstellst kurze, verständliche Videos zur Plattform sowie Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen, Checklisten und Antworten auf häufige Fragen – eigenständig oder gemeinsam mit Kollegen. Du baust eine gut auffindbare Wissensbasis auf, mit der Kunden typische Fragen selbst klären können.

  • Skalierbare Abläufe und Automatisierung gestalten: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Arbeit und entwickelst sinnvolle Lösungen, zum Beispiel für Terminbuchung, Onboarding-Erinnerungen, Aufgabenübergaben und Nachverfolgung. Du nutzt passende digitale Werkzeuge und setzt um, was du selbst umsetzen kannst. Programmierung, Schnittstellen und komplexere technische Umsetzung übernimmst du gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Kollegen; du musst dafür nicht selbst programmieren können.

  • Aus Kundensicht denken: Du verstehst, was Kunden beim Einstieg brauchen, wo Unsicherheit entsteht und welche Informationen sie wann wirklich weiterbringen. Du gestaltest das Onboarding verständlich, in passenden Schritten und ohne Informationsüberflutung. Dabei verbindest du Einfühlungsvermögen und ein Verständnis für Lernen, Motivation und Vertrauen mit konkreten Hilfen für den Arbeitsalltag.

  • Persönlichen Kundenkontakt halten: Du führst Teams-Meetings und Telefonate, erklärst Funktionen verständlich und begleitest Kunden bei ihren nächsten Schritten. Du erkennst, welche Fragen eine persönliche Antwort brauchen und welche sich durch gute Inhalte oder Prozesse einfacher lösen lassen.

  • Anliegen bis zur Klärung nachhalten: Du nimmst Rückfragen und Probleme auf, priorisierst sie mit dem Team und koordinierst technische Themen mit Entwicklung und Technik. Du hältst Kunden über den Stand auf dem Laufenden und prüfst nach, ob die Lösung hilft.

  • Kundeninformationen strukturiert pflegen: Du dokumentierst Kontakte, Absprachen, Onboarding-Fortschritt und offene Aufgaben im CRM bzw. in unserer zentralen Kundenübersicht. Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen und Übergaben auch für andere im Team verständlich sind.

  • Verbesserungen nachvollziehbar machen: Du beobachtest mit uns, wo Kunden im Onboarding hängen bleiben, welche Fragen häufig wiederkehren und wie viel Betreuungszeit benötigt wird. Du verbesserst Inhalte und Abläufe anhand von Kundenfeedback, Plattformnutzung und Zeitaufwand – mit dem Ziel, mehr Kunden bei verlässlicher Betreuungsqualität zu begleiten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Perfektes, verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift ist die wichtigste Voraussetzung. Du führst Telefonate und Teams-Gespräche souverän auf Deutsch, verstehst Rückfragen präzise und erklärst auch komplexere Zusammenhänge klar.

  • Du verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens auf B2-Niveau; C1 ist wünschenswert. So kannst du dich auch mit englischsprachigen Kollegen abstimmen und englische Tools und Unterlagen sicher nutzen.

  • Du kommunizierst freundlich, verbindlich und aufmerksam, hörst gut zu und bleibst auch bei unzufriedenen Kunden sachlich und lösungsorientiert.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert: Du behältst Termine und offene Aufgaben im Blick, hältst Zusagen ein und fragst gezielt nach, wenn dir Informationen fehlen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, neue Abläufe aufzubauen und dich in digitale Produkte einzuarbeiten. Du gehst sicher mit Videokonferenzen, E-Mail und digitalen Arbeitswerkzeugen um.

  • Du bringst drei bis fünf Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, im Customer Success oder im Kunden-Onboarding mit. Du hast Kunden bereits eigenständig betreut, Gespräche geführt und Anliegen zuverlässig bis zur Klärung begleitet. Diese Erfahrung ist eine zentrale Voraussetzung für die Rolle.

  • Du weißt, wie man Onboarding und Customer Success skalierbar gestaltet: durch sinnvolle Standards, wiederverwendbare Inhalte, passende digitale Tools und gezielte Automatisierung. Du kannst Kundenbedürfnisse und typische Hürden in einen klaren Ablauf übersetzen und erklären, welche Schritte du selbst umsetzt und wo du Unterstützung brauchst.

  • Programmierkenntnisse sind keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind dein Verständnis für Kundenprozesse, deine Fähigkeit, gute Lösungen zu konzipieren, und die Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen, die die technische Umsetzung unterstützen.

  • Du kannst die Bedienung einer Software verständlich erklären und daraus brauchbare Schulungsinhalte entwickeln. Erfahrung mit Bildschirmaufnahmen, kurzen Erklärvideos oder einer Wissensdatenbank ist ein Vorteil.

  • Besonders von Vorteil sind Berührungspunkte mit B2B-Kunden, Produktion, Fertigung, Industrie oder technischer Software. Das erleichtert dir den Einstieg in die Themen unserer Kunden. Branchenwissen ist ein Plus; ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist keine Voraussetzung.

Arbeitsort, Arbeitszeit und Kundenbesuche

Du startest mit 20 Stunden pro Woche. Die Verteilung stimmen wir gemeinsam ab, damit unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden zu vereinbarten Zeiten eine verlässliche Ansprechperson haben. Bei Remote-Arbeit aus einer anderen Zeitzone sollten diese Kontaktzeiten ebenfalls möglich sein.

Du kannst weltweit remote arbeiten. Die Zusammenarbeit bei uns in Hannover ist willkommen und bevorzugt, wenn es für dich passt. Nähe zu Hannover ist ein Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Gelegentliche persönliche Besprechungen bei uns – zum Beispiel ein- bis zweimal im Monat – sind nach Absprache möglich und freiwillig.

Wenn du deine Kunden auch persönlich kennenlernen möchtest, kannst du sie nach Abstimmung vor Ort besuchen, beispielsweise ein- bis zweimal im Monat oder seltener. Kundenbesuche sind vollständig optional; es gibt keine verpflichtende Reisequote. Für vereinbarte Besuche stellen wir ein Firmenfahrzeug zur Verfügung. Alternativ kannst du öffentliche Verkehrsmittel oder nach Absprache dein eigenes Fahrzeug nutzen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Eine Teilzeitrolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust einen skalierbaren Customer-Success-Bereich auf und verbindest persönliche Kundenbetreuung mit wiederverwendbarem Onboarding und Automatisierung.

  • Unterstützung durch unsere Kollegen: Du kannst Ideen eigenständig umsetzen und für technische Fragen, Programmierung, Inhalte oder Integrationen mit dem Team zusammenarbeiten. Du wirst schrittweise in WatchMen, unsere Lösungen und die Kundenanwendungen eingearbeitet.

  • Persönlicher Kontakt zu Menschen aus produzierenden Unternehmen und eine Aufgabe, bei der verständliche Kommunikation und verlässliches Nachhalten einen konkreten Unterschied machen.

  • Eine Bruttovergütung von 18.000 bis 24.000 Euro pro Jahr für 20 Wochenstunden, abhängig von Erfahrung und Profil.

Dein Einstieg

Zu Beginn lernst du WatchMen, das Team und deine Kunden kennen und sammelst die wichtigsten offenen Themen. Gemeinsam priorisieren wir die häufigsten Hürden aus Kundensicht. Daraus entwickelst du einen ersten Onboarding-Ablauf und wenige besonders hilfreiche Videos oder Anleitungen. Du planst eine passende erste Automatisierung und setzt sie eigenständig oder mit unseren technischen Kollegen um. Du erprobst diese Bausteine mit ausgewählten Kunden, holst Feedback ein und baust sie schrittweise aus. Persönliche Teams-Termine und Telefonate bleiben Teil der Betreuung. Prioritäten und Umfang stimmen wir auf deine 20-Stunden-Woche ab.

Möchtest du Customer Success bei Novo AI mit aufbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu deiner bisherigen Kundenbetreuung. Erzähle uns gern von einem Onboarding-Prozess oder einer Verbesserung, an der du mitgewirkt hast, und nenne deinen möglichen Starttermin sowie die gewünschte Verteilung deiner 20 Wochenstunden.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Aa Senior Account Executive, you’ll be the primary connection between GitLab and our Commercial & Enterprise customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world’s most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager and partnering closely with business development, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll run the full sales process: shaping the customer’s journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, ensuring accurate pipeline based on evidence, and sharing root-cause insights on wins and losses. In your first year, you’ll focus on building trusted relationships, delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers, and being the voice of the customer internally by contributing ideas to our public issue tracker and improving our sales handbook.

What you’ll do

  • Report to an Regional Sales Director and own a broad book of Commercial & Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.
  • Manage the full sales cycle for Commercial & Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.
  • Support GitLab for Commercial & Enterprise prospects by clearly articulating our DevSecOps value proposition and aligning it to customer business outcomes.
  • Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.
  • Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline.
  • Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement.
  • Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success.
  • Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business.
  • Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions.
  • Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes.
  • Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities.
  • Interest in GitLab, open source software, and preferably familiarity with Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management.
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values and an interest in contributing from diverse or transferable sales backgrounds, with willingness to travel in line with company policy.

About the team

The Commercial & Enterprise Sales team focuses on helping growing organizations adopt and expand GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform across their software delivery lifecycle. You’ll join a distributed group of Account Executives, sales managers, and business development team members who collaborate asynchronously across regions to manage a broad book of business in the mid-market segment. We partner closely with marketing, sales development, and technical teams to run an efficient, transparent sales process, document what works in our sales handbook, and represent the voice of the customer back into GitLab. We focus on opportunities like supporting customers through toolchain consolidation, driving platform adoption, and sharing learnings from wins and losses to continuously improve how we sell and support GitLab.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Healthcare & Life Science
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic based in Seoul, you’ll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with top enterprises within Korea’s Healthcare & Life Sciences space — pharmaceutical and biotech companies, CDMOs and CROs, medical device and diagnostics makers, hospital systems, and digital health companies — unlocking new value streams throughout their business. You’ll leverage your consultative sales expertise to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to customers, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities. In collaboration with GTM, product, and marketing teams, you’ll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to ensure differentiated value across the Korean landscape.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic’s emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic in Korea. Find your way to the right people at prospective customers, educate them about LLMs, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You’ll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to launch
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyze the Korean Healthcare & Life Sciences landscape, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities, partnerships, and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by pinpointing new customer segments and use cases across R&D, clinical development, regulatory and quality, manufacturing, and patient- and provider-facing functions. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings and sustain a competitive edge
  • Help customers navigate Korea’s healthcare regulatory and data environment, including Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) and Ministry of Health and Welfare (MOHW) requirements, the Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and Medical Service Act as they apply to patient data, and GxP/validation expectations
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering customer feedback and conveying the needs of the Korean market. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition and enhance the customer experience
  • Continuously refine the sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 8+ years of enterprise Healthcare & Life Sciences sales experience in Korea, driving adoption of emerging technologies with a consultative, solutions-oriented sales approach
  • A genuine understanding of how Korean hospitals and life sciences companies make technology decisions, including the role of regulators, quality and compliance functions, and IT governance
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles and securing strategic deals by understanding multifaceted technical requirements and crafting tailored solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate dynamic stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus and providing innovative solutions to disparate groups
  • Extensive experience negotiating highly complex, customized commercial agreements with multiple stakeholders
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in fast-paced organizations by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills in both Korean and English, and the ability to present confidently and build connections across all customer levels, from ICs to C-level executives
  • A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. You are a true team player

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

OTE $270K - $300K (50/50 base to variable). Offers equity.

We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

Aa Senior Account Executive, you’ll be the primary connection between GitLab and our Commercial & Enterprise customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world’s most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager and partnering closely with business development, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll run the full sales process: shaping the customer’s journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, ensuring accurate pipeline based on evidence, and sharing root-cause insights on wins and losses. In your first year, you’ll focus on building trusted relationships, delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers, and being the voice of the customer internally by contributing ideas to our public issue tracker and improving our sales handbook.

What you’ll do

  • Report to an Regional Sales Director and own a broad book of Commercial & Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.
  • Manage the full sales cycle for Commercial & Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.
  • Support GitLab for Commercial & Enterprise prospects by clearly articulating our DevSecOps value proposition and aligning it to customer business outcomes.
  • Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analyses, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.
  • Document and maintain accurate buying criteria, buying processes, next steps, and owners to ensure a reliable, evidence-based pipeline.
  • Contribute to improving our sales handbook and processes by documenting best practices and opportunities for refinement.
  • Provide account leadership and direction across pre- and post-sales, partnering closely with technical teams and customer success.
  • Represent the voice of the customer by contributing product feedback and ideas to our public issue tracker.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven success in software sales, ideally in a Enterprise market context, managing a varied book of business.
  • Ability to guide customers through the full buying journey, including defining buying criteria, mapping buying processes, and driving clear next steps.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with business development, marketing, technical teams, and sales management.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining accurate pipeline data and account plans based on evidence rather than assumptions.
  • Skill in conducting and contributing to win/loss and root cause analyses, and sharing insights to improve team performance and processes.
  • Proficiency in negotiation, presenting to customer stakeholders, and leading commercial discussions to close opportunities.
  • Interest in GitLab, open source software, and preferably familiarity with Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management.
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values and an interest in contributing from diverse or transferable sales backgrounds, with willingness to travel in line with company policy.

The Commercial & Enterprise Sales team focuses on helping growing organizations adopt and expand GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform across their software delivery lifecycle. title: Partner Account Manager - DACH
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As Partner Account Manager you will help manage and execute the partnerships that accelerate Claude adoption, unlock new capabilities and drive outcomes for our joint customers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
You will own a defined set of named partners end to end — a mix of (a) in-country DACH practices of our global system integrators (e.g. Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, PwC, BCG), where you work hand in hand with the GSI alliance owners who hold the global relationships, and (b) regional system integrators, consultancies and AI-native boutiques that DACH enterprises and the Mittelstand actually buy from. The DACH partner book is split between you and the Head of Partnerships DACH and CEE; for every partner assigned to you, you own the plan, the enablement path, the co-sell motion with our DACH sales team and the partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline that results from it. This is a builder role: partner-sourced pipeline in DACH is still a small fraction of our open pipeline, and there is a first playbook but no established machine. We need someone who has taken partnerships from zero to a repeatable revenue engine in this market before, not someone who has inherited and administered an existing partner book.

Key responsibilities

Partner development and execution:

  • Run each partner as a structured pursuit: stakeholder map (country lead, AI/data practice lead, alliance lead, key account partners), joint account plan, agreed target accounts and a quarterly cadence.

  • For your assigned GSI country practices: activate the DACH teams against the global frameworks and translate them into concrete joint accounts. For your assigned regional SIs / boutiques: build the relationship from scratch (selection, onboarding into the Claude Partner Network, enablement, first joint deals).

  • Guide partners in building repeatable Claude offerings (agentic engineering rollouts, agentic use cases, enterprise adoption programs) for the priority DACH industries: automotive and manufacturing, financial services and insurance, public sector, telco, pharma and chemicals.

  • Drive co-selling with the DACH AEs, Applied AI and Technical Success teams: introduce partners into the right accounts, bring partner-sourced opportunities to sales, and make sure every partner-attached deal is tagged correctly in Salesforce.

Performance and KPI ownership:

  • Own and drive the KPIs for your portfolio: Partner delivered use-cases, partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced pipeline and revenue, consultants enabled and certified, partners progressing through CPN tiers, joint proposals submitted.

  • Establish clear success metrics with each partner and drive regular business reviews against targets

  • Report on partnership health, progress, and commercial outcomes with data-driven insights

  • Every deal that runs through your partners must be set up for customer success and expansion: agree success criteria for joint accounts, make sure the partner delivers implementation and adoption support, and feed what you learn back into our partner program and the DACH sales team.

Market development and brand building

  • Represent Anthropic in the DACH partner ecosystem — partner events, joint customer events, and partner-led marketing in German.

  • Adapt the global partner playbook to DACH buying behaviour (Mittelstand vs. DAX/SMI enterprises, long procurement cycles, works councils, preference for local delivery partners) and decide deliberately what not to copy.

  • Navigate the regulatory and sovereignty topics that come up in almost every DACH deal (GDPR, EU AI Act, data residency, regulated industries such as banking and insurance) together with the partner and our internal experts.

  • Build differentiated joint value propositions with partners so that Claude is the default recommendation of the DACH consulting ecosystem.

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Builder mentality — comfortable starting from a small base and turning it into a scaled partner business; you enjoy doing the work yourself.

  • 8+ years of partner / alliances / channel experience with system integrators and consultancies in DACH, ideally at a cloud, data or AI platform company.

  • Existing relationships in the DACH practices of the large SIs and/or with the regional consultancies and boutiques — you know who runs the AI and data practices in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

  • Data-driven, KPI-oriented and comfortable being measured on partner-sourced pipeline; a track record of driving incremental revenue through partners in DACH.

  • History of protecting the customer experience and the brand through partners — you say no to partners that cannot deliver.

  • Competitive drive — obsessed with winning and creating differentiation

  • Collaborative — you work as an extension of the DACH sales team and with Applied AI, Technical Success, partner marketing and the global GSI alliance owners.

  • Business-fluent German (C1+ / native) and English; able to run partner executive conversations and enablement sessions in German.

  • Based in Germany and willing to travel regularly within DE / AT / CH and occasionally to London and San Francisco.

  • Passion for AI and alignment with Anthropic's mission of beneficial AI development

Working Relationships

You will formally report to the International Partnerships leader, while your day-to-day work will be led by our DACH and CEE Partnerships leader who is based in Munich. You will also partner closely with Anthropic's regional sales leader and their Account Executives, as well as the in-region Customer Success and Technical Account Management teams.

Location and Travel

Based in Germany, ideally Munich; Berlin or Frankfurt are possible with regular time in Munich and with the sales team. Regular travel to partners and customers across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, plus occasional travel to London (partner leadership) and San Francisco (onboarding).

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
€160.000—€220.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. We're seeking a business development lead to own Anthropic's BD partnership footprint with a small number of the world's largest and most consequential technology companies. These are not single-threaded accounts. You will guide customers as they move from provisioned accounts to a live, value-generating deployment. You are a Cloudflare product expert and will leverage your knowledge to ensure our customers understand and utilize the Cloudflare platform to its fullest extent. This is a customer-facing technical role focused on post-sale onboarding, technical advisory, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical events. You will be collaborating with CEs, AEs, Support and other internal teams to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Customer Onboarding and Deployment Readiness: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Guide customers through onboarding and implementation runbooks and identify when an engagement requires escalation to the appropriate Cloudflare team. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures.
  • Cloudflare Configuration Guidance: Guide customers through Cloudflare configuration steps for applicable platform capabilities, including DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, Application Security, Zero Trust/SASE, Network Services, and other Cloudflare products as assigned.   • Technical Breadth and Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare product foundations, including Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services, at a depth appropriate to onboarding, adoption, troubleshooting, and technical advisory scenarios. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, internal process updates, and relevant certifications. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support your work.

  • Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.

  • Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Configuration and integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.

Strong written and verbal communication skills. Able to document clearly, summarize concisely, and interact professionally with both technical and non-technical customer contacts. Regulatory and Security Awareness (Nice-to-Haves): Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 is a plus.

  • Cloudflare Certifications: Existing Cloudflare certifications (e.g., Cloudflare Fundamentals, Cloudflare for Teams, or Cloudflare for Developers).

Regional Focus: Telcos & Service Providers across MEA Emerging Markets

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished Senior Named Account Executive to drive Cloudflare’s growth within the Telcos and Service Provider sector across MEA Emerging Markets.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for a seasoned enterprise sales professional with deep experience engaging some of the region’s largest telecommunications operators, service providers and digital infrastructure organizations. While Telcos and Service Providers will be the primary focus, experience successfully selling into other strategic verticals, including Public Sector, Energy and Financial Services, is highly desirable.

The successful candidate will bring an established network of senior relationships across the region, a strong understanding of Telco and Service Provider business and technology priorities, and a proven ability to originate, develop, negotiate and close large, complex, multi-stakeholders projects.

The role requires the ability to operate credibly from the C-suite and senior business leadership level through to technical decision makers across networking, security, cloud, and infrastructure. The candidate will combine exceptional enterprise sales capabilities with sufficient technical depth to understand complex customer environments and position Cloudflare’s Connectivity platform against strategic business and technology outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Telco & Service Provider Growth
Own and execute the go-to-market strategy for assigned Telco and Service Provider accounts across the region, developing comprehensive territory and account plans designed to drive significant new business and expansion revenue.

Executive Relationship Development
Build, maintain and expand trusted relationships across major regional Telcos and Service Providers, engaging C-suite executives, senior business leaders, technology executives and key technical stakeholders.

New Logo Acquisition & Account Expansion
Identify and develop new strategic opportunities while expanding Cloudflare’s footprint within existing customers through broader platform adoption and engagement across multiple business units.

Complex Enterprise Sales Leadership
Lead sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical, commercial, procurement, legal, regulatory and executive stakeholders. Navigate complex customer organizations and buying processes to drive opportunities through successful closure.

Customer & Technology Understanding
Develop a strong understanding of customer IT and network architectures, including cloud, connectivity, cybersecurity, applications and third-party technologies. Work closely with Cloudflare technical teams to align customer requirements with relevant Cloudflare architectures and solutions.

Strategic Value Creation
Translate Cloudflare’s technology capabilities into compelling business outcomes. Clearly articulate how Cloudflare can support customers’ strategic priorities including digital transformation, network modernization, cybersecurity, cloud transformation, application modernization and AI-related initiatives.

Pipeline & Forecast Management
Maintain disciplined and proactive pipeline management, consistently developing sufficient pipeline coverage and providing accurate, timely and evidence-based forecasting.

Virtual Team Leadership
Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solution Engineering, Product Specialists, Customer Success, Channel, Deal Desk and Legal to develop and close complex strategic opportunities.

Commercial Negotiation & Closure
Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations involving large enterprise agreements, multi-year commitments and strategic platform engagements, creating sustainable outcomes for both Cloudflare and its customers.

Market & Competitive Intelligence
Maintain a deep understanding of the Telco and Service Provider landscape across Emerging Markets, including customer priorities, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations, technology trends and evolving investment areas.

Organizational Leadership
Operates as a senior leader within the broader sales organization, sharing market insights, best practices and customer learnings while mentoring colleagues and contributing to Cloudflare’s long-term regional growth strategy.

Experience & Qualifications

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • 20+ years of overall professional sales experience, preferably within enterprise technology, cloud, SaaS, networking, cybersecurity, telecommunications or adjacent technology markets.
  • 10+ years of direct experience managing and selling to major Telcos and Service Providers, with established experience across Emerging Markets, particularly Gulf, Levant and North Africa.
  • A proven track record of developing business with leading Tier-1 Telco operators and Service Providers and navigating their complex organizational and procurement structures.
  • Demonstrated success consistently achieving or exceeding multi-million-dollar annual sales quotas.
  • Proven experience originating, developing and closing large multi-million dollar strategic projects, including complex multi-year agreements.
  • Strong experience selling enterprise SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, networking, edge computing, connectivity or related technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles involving multiple business units, geographies, decision-makers and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of the technology priorities affecting Telcos and Service Providers, including cloud transformation, network modernization, cybersecurity, connectivity, edge computing and emerging AI-related infrastructure requirements.
  • Ability to understand complex customer IT and network architectures and work effectively with technical teams to translate these into relevant solution architectures and commercial opportunities.

  • Experience applying structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or equivalent.
  • Proven ability to lead and engage virtual, cross-functional teams through complex strategic opportunities.
  • Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills and forecasting discipline.
  • A highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial and resilient approach, with the ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures.

Languages

  • Fluent Arabic and English are required.
  • French is highly desirable.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Telecommunications/Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline is strongly preferred).
  • Additional postgraduate business or technology qualifications are advantageous.

Travel

The role is based in Dubai, UAE and requires regular travel across Emerging Markets to engage strategic customers, partners, alliances and internal teams.

What Success Looks Like

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. title: Account Executive 4
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive.

About the job

As a New Business Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving new business opportunities and expanding Twilio's presence in the Latin America’s market. You will work closely with potential clients to understand their communication needs and demonstrate how Twilio's solutions can enhance their business operations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Identify and prospect new business opportunities within the Latin America’s market.
  • Develop and maintain a robust sales pipeline through strategic outreach and networking.
  • Conduct thorough needs assessments to understand customer requirements and tailor Twilio solutions accordingly.
  • Present and demonstrate Twilio's product suite, including Messaging, Voice, Flex, and more, to potential clients.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless onboarding and implementation for new clients.
  • Achieve and exceed sales targets and performance metrics.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and competitive landscape to effectively position Twilio's offerings.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of proven track record of success in B2B sales, preferably within the technology or communications for BPOs, Telcos and/or financial industry
  • Strong understanding of Latin America’s market and business culture.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both Spanish and English.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM software and sales tools.
  • Strong sales discovery skills, objection handling, business acumen, and closing skills.

Desired:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales cycles and negotiate effectively.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Colombia.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
